item.title: Kosol Energie to Install 4 MW Ground-Mounted Solar Plant for Mafatlal Industries
item.description: Kosol Energie Pvt. Ltd. said it will install a 4 megawatt (MW) ground-mounted solar power plant at Mafatlal Industries Ltd.’s manufacturing facility in Nadiad, marking the textile maker’s latest move to increase the use of renewable energy in its operations. item.title: Solar Power Europe Signals End of EU Solar Boom
item.description: Solar Power Europe, the premier solar body in Europe, asserts that the EU solar boom is over. Not only that, the organisation claims that EU’s 2030 renewable targets are at risk now, a situation considered unthinkable as recently as 2023. With a 0.7% contraction from 65.6 GW installed in 2024, to 65.1 GW installed in 2025, this year marks the first year since 2016 where the EU has installed less solar than the year before.
